name: Haldarr Encampment
summary: In western Azshara, Haldarr satyrs hold a corrupted outpost northeast of Shadowsong Shrine and southwest of Valormok. Their camp blights ancient elven ruins, and the injured Night Elf Sentinel Keldara Sunblade lies among them.

sections.title: A Den of Demon-Spawn
sections.body: Broken stones mark the Haldarr satyrs’ camp in western Azshara. These twisted creatures descend from the Highborne and were cursed by demonic corruption during the Sundering. They hunt and harass anyone crossing the autumn forests. Their crowded settlement threatens the Horde forces at nearby Valormok and the dwindling Night Elf sentinels watching the region.

sections.title: The Captured Sentinel
sections.body: Sentinel Keldara Sunblade lies injured among the satyrs, deep in enemy territory. No account tells why she remains there.

faq.answer: Haldarr satyrs control a corrupted settlement in western Azshara, northeast of Shadowsong Shrine and southwest of Valormok.

The Haldarr are a vicious sect of satyrs living in Azshara. Like all satyrs, they descend from ancient Night Elves who embraced demonic pacts during the War of the Ancients. They were cursed into goat-legged fiends who serve the remnants of the Burning Legion’s will.
Sentinel Keldara Sunblade is a wounded Night Elf Sentinel inside the Haldarr Encampment, surrounded by hostile satyrs. No account tells why she is there.

faq.q: Why is this camp dangerous to nearby travelers?
faq.answer: Aggressive satyrs crowd the camp and threaten the surrounding paths. They endanger Horde operations from Valormok and any wandering scouts in the area.

angles.text: For the Kaldorei, the Haldarr satyrs remain a shameful reminder of the ancient Highborne’s descent into demonic madness.
Just southwest of Valormok, this dense nest of demons threatens Horde scouts and supply lines pushing across Azshara’s cliffs.
